thread:
jamie: heads up — started staged rollout for runtime v3-quant at 10% for llm-inference. Observing p99 on short prompts jumped from ~170ms -> ~310ms. anyone else seeing this? @sasha

sasha: yup saw the spike on the per-route dashboard. GPU busy, batch sizes smaller than expected. I toggled batcher to legacy mode on the canary pool — slight improvement but p99 still high. attaching perf-bot summary.

perf-bot: perf-check results for v3-quant @10%: p50 60ms, p95 180ms, p99 310ms (baseline p99=160ms). GPU util 72% -> 88%. kv-cache hit rate 38% (expected ~70%).

owen: can we pause promotion? i propose we halt next step until root cause identified. also need flamegraphs + nvprof traces from a canary host.

marta: agree. pausing promotion now. @aditya can you run a targeted microbench on infra-staging with the canonical short prompts and `make perf-test TARGET=v3-quant`? need triton logs and `kubectl top pods` snapshot.

aditya: on it. will run tests and collect `perf-collect` bundle. ETA ~30m.

jamie: quick question — did the new compilation/kernel selection change this rollout? the policy included `kernel-choose v2`. if that's the culprit we can pin `REDWOOD_KERNEL=stable-2025-11` on the canary nodes.

sasha: we did flip kernel-choose earlier this week — marking as suspect. also noticed autoscaler kept small batches; looks like continuous-batching config wasn't applied to the variant.

owen: if kv-cache warmup is low, first-window tokens will be slower. check trace ids for cache-miss ratio. perf-bot, can you emit `cache_miss_ratio` per shard?

perf-bot: emitting metrics now: cache_miss_ratio -> shard0:0.62, shard1:0.59, shard2:0.64. high miss rate confirmed.

marta: plan: 1) pause rollout 2) aditya runs perf tests + collect flamegraphs 3) sasha either revert kernel-choose on canary pool or pin kernel env 4) owen to validate batching config & cache behavior 5) reconvene in 45m and decide if we route traffic back to v3-quant-compat (older variant).

aditya: tests started. i'll upload `perf-bundle-1772654355.tar.gz` to artifacts when done.

jamie: also pinging @infra-team for possible GPU driver mismatch — there was a driver update yesterday on dedicated nodes.

sasha: :thumbsup: i'll check driver versions on canary nodes and compare to baseline pool.

owen: short mitigation idea: we can temporarily force route `stable` for requests with `route_hint: low_latency` in the router to prefer the older variant. ugly but buys time.

marta: please add short status updates in-thread once you have logs (flamegraph, nvprof, batcher logs). if we decide to revert, i'll file a release-action to shift the 10% back to v3-quant-compat and note the perf regression.

aditya: uploaded artifact: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/perf-bundle-1772654355.tar.gz (contains flamegraphs, triton logs, `kubectl top` snapshots, and `perf-collect` output).

jamie: thanks all. marking thread with :pause_button: until next update.
